summary.en: Static support for the schematic classroom model.
summary.zh: 示意课堂模型的静态支撑。

detail.en: This static DESIGN structure supports the visible specimen. It is not selectable and carries no measured acoustic properties. [S1]
detail.zh: 这个静态设计结构支撑可见实验物件，不可选中，也不承载实测声学参数。[S1]

summary.en: Two arms share a U-shaped root and handle.
summary.zh: 两臂共用一个U形叉底和柄。

detail.en: A single U joins the two equal arms to one handle. Its small marker illustrates local vibration while the metal reference stays still. This is a silent DESIGN specimen, not a measured tuning fork. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 两条等长叉臂通过一个U形底部与单柄连在一起。小点示意局部振动，金属本体保留静止外形。它是静音设计模型，非实测音叉。[S1, S5]

summary.en: A small point traces enlarged local motion.
summary.zh: 小点示意放大的局部运动。

detail.en: This point sits beside one fork arm. Two fixed angular marker motions illustrate relative amplitude; they share the slowed wave phase. The 0.035/0.07 u values describe the wave strip only, not these marker arcs. [S1]
detail.zh: 小点放在一条叉臂旁。两种固定角摆示意相对振幅，与慢放纵波共用相位。0.035/0.07u仅描述波条位移，不是这些圆弧标记的测量值。[S1]

summary.en: Static support for the schematic classroom model.

detail.en: This static DESIGN structure supports the visible specimen. It is not selectable and carries no measured acoustic properties. [S1]
detail.zh: 这个静态设计结构支撑可见实验物件，不可选中，也不承载实测声学参数。[S1]

summary.en: A hollow frame supports one stretched membrane.
summary.zh: 空心鼓框支撑一层绷紧的膜。

detail.en: A thin annular shell has an open bottom and a cut-open front that exposes its cavity. It supports one membrane, with no lower membrane. The structure is a DESIGN reference, not a solved resonator. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 薄环形鼓框开底，前部切口露出空腔；它只支撑上面一层膜，没有下鼓面。结构是设计参考，不是求解过的共鸣器。[S1, S5]

summary.en: One membrane spans the top of the drum frame.
summary.zh: 一层薄膜覆盖鼓框顶端。

detail.en: One thin circular membrane rests on the upper rim. A separate point indicates motion near its centre. The membrane stays as a structural reference: no membrane mode or exact pitch is calculated. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 一层薄圆膜靠在鼓框上沿。独立小点示意中央附近的运动。膜本体保留结构参考，不计算真实振型或精确音调。[S1, S5]

summary.en: A separate point marks local membrane motion.
summary.zh: 独立小点示意鼓面的局部运动。

detail.en: The point at the membrane centre follows a short illustrative arc. It does not translate the whole drumhead or claim to reproduce a membrane vibration mode. Its amplitude is schematic. [S1]
detail.zh: 鼓面中央小点沿短弧示意运动，不把整张膜平移，也不声称重现真实鼓面振型。它的运动幅度是示意值。[S1]

summary.en: The same driver acts on each medium specimen.
summary.zh: 同一驱动面作用于每种介质。

detail.en: A small diaphragm faces the medium at x = −1.15 u. Its local angular wobble is an enlarged vibration symbol. The driver remains enabled in vacuum, while the transmission outputs say there is no medium. This is not a measured diaphragm mode. [S1, S3, S5]
detail.zh: 小驱动膜面向x=−1.15u处的介质。局部角摆是放大的振动符号；真空时驱动仍可启用，而传播读数显示无介质。这不是实测的膜振型。[S1, S3, S5]

summary.en: Static support for the schematic classroom model.
summary.zh: 示意课堂模型的静态支撑。

detail.en: This static DESIGN structure supports the visible specimen. It is not selectable and carries no measured acoustic properties. [S1]
detail.zh: 这个静态设计结构支撑可见实验物件，不可选中，也不承载实测声学参数。[S1]

summary.en: Air is matter through which sound can travel.
summary.zh: 空气是可传播声音的物质。

detail.en: The open schematic channel marks the air-filled gap between source and receiver. The 41 dots represent local equilibrium positions in air. They oscillate locally: no parcel of air travels to the receiver. [S1, S3, S5]
detail.zh: 敞开的示意槽标出声源和接收处之间的空气区。41个点代表空气中的局部平衡位置；它们在附近往复，不代表一团空气旅行到接收处。[S1, S3, S5]

summary.en: Water can transmit sound through matter.
summary.zh: 水能通过物质传播声音。

detail.en: A matching channel contains a static thin water layer touching the same end faces. The model uses 1500 m/s as a teaching comparison. No water-particle wave or surface-water motion is simulated. [S1, S3, S16]
detail.zh: 相同的槽内有一层静止水，接触同样的两端面。模型以1500m/s作教学比较，不模拟水粒子纵波或水面运动。[S1, S3, S16]

summary.en: A continuous solid connects driver and receiver.
summary.zh: 连续固体连接驱动面与接收面。

detail.en: This bar joins the driver contact at −1.15 u to the receiver contact at 0.95 u. Its DESIGN speed is 5000 m/s for one chosen uniform solid. This is not the speed of every solid or a rule based on density alone. [S1, S3]
detail.zh: 固体杆从−1.15u的驱动接触面连续连接到0.95u的接收接触面。5000m/s是选定均匀固体的设计声速，不代表所有固体，也不是只按密度排序的规律。[S1, S3]

summary.en: This surface marks where transmission is checked.
summary.zh: 这个表面标示观察传播的位置。

detail.en: The disc marks a generic receiving surface, not an ear. Three tilted poses are qualitative symbols for transmitted, source off and no medium; they are not timed sensor detections. The readout gives the model state explicitly. [S1, S3]
detail.zh: 圆盘代表通用接收面，不画成耳朵。三种倾斜姿态定性标示可传播、声源关闭和无介质，不代表精确计时的传感器检测；读数明确给出模型状态。[S1, S3]

summary.en: Static support for the schematic classroom model.

detail.en: This static DESIGN structure supports the visible specimen. It is not selectable and carries no measured acoustic properties. [S1]
detail.zh: 这个静态设计结构支撑可见实验物件，不可选中，也不承载实测声学参数。[S1]

summary.en: A fixed tick locates the fifth highlighted point.
summary.zh: 固定刻度标出第5号高亮点的静止位置。

detail.en: This fixed tick sits at x = −0.85 u: particle index 5 rests a quarter unit from the strip origin. The moving highlighted particle stays near this tick rather than travelling across the strip. Scene units are schematic. [S1, S3]
detail.zh: 固定刻度在x=−0.85u；第5号点的静止位置距波条原点0.25u。高亮点只在刻度附近往复，不横穿整条波条。场景单位仅作示意。[S1, S3]

summary.en: The outward pulse starts at this marked position.
summary.zh: 向外脉冲从这个标记位置开始。

detail.en: This small disc marks the common physical position of the source and receiver. The pulse sphere is an envelope-position symbol, not a medium particle. Visual separation in z prevents overlapping faces and changes no calculated distance. [S1, S17]
detail.zh: 小圆盘标示声源与接收处共用的物理位置。脉冲球是包络位置符号，不是介质粒子；z方向的微小错开仅避免表面重叠，不改变计算距离。[S1, S17]

summary.en: The returning pulse reaches the source position.
summary.zh: 返回脉冲到达声源所在的位置。

detail.en: The receiver shares the emitter position in the calculation. Its disc is drawn slightly aside in z. A return covers the distance to the reflector twice; the model does not calculate absorption or room reverberation. [S1, S17]
detail.zh: 计算中接收处与发射处共址；图中圆盘仅在z方向略微错开。返回过程要走两次到反射面的距离；模型不计算吸收或房间混响。[S1, S17]

summary.en: A preset wall represents 17 m one-way distance.
summary.zh: 预设墙代表17米单程距离。

detail.en: This flat reflector represents a source-to-wall distance of 17 m. Its scene position is a schematic preset, not a uniform map scale. Only one wall is visible at once. The pulse uses the same distance control as the return-time calculation. [S1, S17]
detail.zh: 平面反射墙代表声源到墙17米。场景位置是示意预设，不是统一比例尺；每次只显示一面墙。脉冲与返回时间计算使用同一个距离控制。[S1, S17]

summary.en: A preset wall represents 34 m one-way distance.
summary.zh: 预设墙代表34米单程距离。

detail.en: This flat reflector represents a source-to-wall distance of 34 m. Its scene position is a schematic preset, not a uniform map scale. Only one wall is visible at once. The pulse uses the same distance control as the return-time calculation. [S1, S17]
detail.zh: 平面反射墙代表声源到墙34米。场景位置是示意预设，不是统一比例尺；每次只显示一面墙。脉冲与返回时间计算使用同一个距离控制。[S1, S17]

summary.en: A preset wall represents 68 m one-way distance.
summary.zh: 预设墙代表68米单程距离。

detail.en: This flat reflector represents a source-to-wall distance of 68 m. Its scene position is a schematic preset, not a uniform map scale. Only one wall is visible at once. The pulse uses the same distance control as the return-time calculation. [S1, S17]
detail.zh: 平面反射墙代表声源到墙68米。场景位置是示意预设，不是统一比例尺；每次只显示一面墙。脉冲与返回时间计算使用同一个距离控制。[S1, S17]

summary.en: A hollow box helps couple string motion to air.
summary.zh: 空心箱体帮助弦的振动传给空气。

detail.en: A hollow wooden box has one round sound hole in its upper board. Two end posts anchor one string; a fixed bridge and one selected movable bridge support its active length. The model shows structure and coupling, not a measured resonance spectrum. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 木制空心箱顶板只有一个圆形音孔。两端柱固定一根弦；固定桥与当前选中的可移动桥支撑有效弦段。模型展示结构与耦合，不是实测的共振频谱。[S1, S5]

summary.en: A single taut string spans two anchored ends.
summary.zh: 一根绷紧的弦连着两个固定端。

detail.en: One continuous thin string runs between the two anchors and across its supports. The long and short bridge presets halve the active length in this DESIGN. At fixed other conditions a shorter vibrating string has a higher pitch; no tension is measured here. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 一根细弦连续连接两端锚点，并经过支撑桥。长短预设把有效弦长减半，这是设计值。其他相关条件不变时，较短振动弦段的音调较高；这里没有实测张力。[S1, S5]

summary.en: A movable support selects the vibrating length.
summary.zh: 可移动支撑选择有效振动弦长。

detail.en: Only one movable bridge is present in each preset. Its tip meets the same taut string; the fixed bridge stays at the other end. The short preset has half the active length and selects the 500 Hz teaching setting. This is a structural preset, not a tension solver. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 每个预设只显示一个可移动桥，桥尖接触同一根绷紧的弦，另一端的固定桥保留。短预设的有效弦长减半，对应500Hz教学设置。这是结构预设，不是张力求解器。[S1, S5]

summary.en: A movable support selects the vibrating length.
summary.zh: 可移动支撑选择有效振动弦长。

detail.en: Only one movable bridge is present in each preset. Its tip meets the same taut string; the fixed bridge stays at the other end. The short preset has half the active length and selects the 500 Hz teaching setting. This is a structural preset, not a tension solver. [S1, S5]
detail.zh: 每个预设只显示一个可移动桥，桥尖接触同一根绷紧的弦，另一端的固定桥保留。短预设的有效弦长减半，对应500Hz教学设置。这是结构预设，不是张力求解器。[S1, S5]

summary.en: An open tube contains a resonating air column.
summary.zh: 开口管容纳可共鸣的空气柱。

detail.en: This pipe is open at both ends; a thin wall surrounds an empty air column. Wind-instrument pitch can change with the effective resonating length. This model does not calculate nodes, antinodes or an instrument fingering. [S1, S7]
detail.zh: 管的两端都开口，薄管壁围着中空空气柱。管乐器音调可随有效共鸣长度改变。这里不计算节点、腹部或实际指法。[S1, S7]

summary.en: The rim leaves the air column open to its surroundings.
summary.zh: 管口边缘让空气柱与外界相通。

detail.en: The ring marks the pipe opening, without a cap or membrane. The visible hollow centre is a structural cue only; no air flow or exact standing-wave pattern is animated. [S1, S7]
detail.zh: 圆环标示没有盖或膜的管口。可见的中空中心只作结构提示，不动画展示气流或精确驻波图样。[S1, S7]

detail.en: This static DESIGN structure supports the visible specimen. It is not selectable and carries no measured acoustic properties. [S1]
detail.zh: 这个静态设计结构支撑可见实验物件，不可选中，也不承载实测声学参数。[S1]

summary.en: A speaker is a familiar sound source.
summary.zh: 扬声器是熟悉的声源。

detail.en: A plain enclosure and front diaphragm identify a speaker without brand or measured level. The near and far poses illustrate moving away as one protective action. They do not calculate decibels or a safe listening duration. [S1, S10, S13]
detail.zh: 普通箱体和前方振膜标示无品牌扬声器，不显示实测声级。远近姿态示意“远离”这一保护行动，不计算分贝或安全聆听时长。[S1, S10, S13]

summary.en: Protection can reduce exposure in noisy places.
summary.zh: 防护可减少嘈杂环境中的暴露。

detail.en: Two padded cups hang from a curved band on a display stand. Appropriate protection is one action alongside reducing volume, limiting time and moving away. This generic object has no certified attenuation rating and is not an ear anatomy model. [S1, S10, S13]
detail.zh: 两只软垫耳杯连着弯头带，放在展示架上。适当防护应结合降低音量、减少时间和远离声源。这个通用模型没有认证衰减等级，也不是耳部解剖模型。[S1, S10, S13]
